input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it’s either not working at all or it’s extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any other information.

Thanks for checking! Before I decide on refueling, could we check if there might be any other causes for the slow or non-working mobile data? I’d like to make sure there’s nothing else going on with my phone or settings first. What should I do next?
I’m ready! Please go ahead and let me know what steps I should follow to check my phone’s network status and settings.

Here are the results from the network status check on my phone:
- Airplane mode is off.
- SIM card is active.
- Cellular connection is connected, but the signal strength is poor.
- The network type is 2G.
- Mobile data is enabled.
- Data roaming is currently disabled.
- Wi-Fi is off and not connected.

What should I do next?

I’ve set my phone’s network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred.” The status bar now shows excellent signal strength and 5G connectivity, with mobile data enabled.

What would you like me to do next?
I tried running the speed test, but it failed and said “No Connection.” What should I do next?
The results show that Data Saver mode is currently ON, which might be limiting my data usage. What should I do next?
I turned Data Saver mode off, but when I tried the speed test again, it still failed and said “No Connection.” What should I try next?
The VPN on my phone is currently ON and connected. The server performance is listed as poor. What should I do next?
I disconnected the VPN and tried the speed test again, but it still failed and says “No Connection.” This is getting a bit frustrating—what else can we try?
Yes, please go ahead and enable roaming on my line. I’m currently abroad, so that might be the issue. Let me know once it’s done or if there’s anything I need to do on my end.
It looks like roaming is still showing as disabled on my phone, even though you enabled it on my line. Should I try restarting my phone now, or is there something else I should do first?
I restarted my phone, but after checking, data roaming still shows as disabled on my phone. My signal is excellent and I’m on 5G, but roaming hasn’t switched on. What should I do next?
I turned data roaming on manually, but the speed test still fails and says “No Connection.” My signal is excellent and I’m on 5G, but I still can’t get any data. What should I try next?
The APN settings on my phone show the APN name as “internet” and the MMSC URL as “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” Do these look correct, or should I try resetting or updating them?

I reset the APN settings to default and restarted my phone, but the speed test still fails and says “No Connection.” My signal is still excellent, I’m on 5G, and data roaming is enabled. What else can we try?
I wasn’t aware of the overdue bill. Yes, please send me the payment request so I can settle it right away. Let me know once it’s sent and what I need to do next.
It looks like I haven’t received a payment request yet. Could you please send it to me so I can pay the overdue bill and hopefully get my mobile data working again?
I’ve completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do next to check if my mobile data is working now?
I made the payment for the overdue bill, but the speed test still fails and says “No Connection.” My mobile data still isn’t working. What else can we try?
I rebooted my phone again, but the speed test still fails and says “No Connection.” My mobile data still isn’t working, even after all these steps. Is there anything else we can try?
###TRANSFER###
